# ItalyGuides.it

> > ItalyGuides.it: Virtual reality travel guides and comprehensive tourist information for Italy's most iconic cities, historical attractions, and archaeological sites.

ItalyGuides.it provides detailed travel guides to Italian destinations including Rome, Venice, Bologna, Palermo, and Agrigento, featuring historical attractions, ancient ruins, and cultural landmarks. The site offers immersive VR experiences and audio tours to help visitors explore Italy's rich heritage.

- Italy tourism
- Historical attractions

## Major Italian Cities

- [Bologna, informazioni turistiche su Bologna](https://www.italyguides.it/it/emilia-romagna/bologna): Tourist guide to Bologna featuring Piazza Maggiore and medieval towers
- [Agrigento, informazioni turistiche su Agrigento](https://www.italyguides.it/it/sicilia/agrigento): Tourist guide to Agrigento Sicily featuring Valle dei Templi ruins

## Archaeological Sites & Ancient Ruins

- [Travel guide of Ancient Ostia Italy](https://www.italyguides.it/en/lazio/ancient-ostia): Travel guide to Ancient Ostia archaeological site near Rome on the Tiber
- [Greek Theater - Taormina, Sicily](https://www.italyguides.it/en/sicily/taormina/greek-theater): Ancient Greek Theater in Taormina Sicily with Roman reconstructions

## Historic Buildings & Monuments

- [Teatro Politeama, Palermo](https://www.italyguides.it/it/sicilia/palermo/teatro-politeama): Guide to Teatro Politeama neoclassical theater in Palermo by Mario Rutelli
- [Basilica Santa Maria dei Servi, Bologna](https://www.italyguides.it/it/emilia-romagna/bologna/basilica-santa-maria-dei-servi): Gothic Basilica Santa Maria dei Servi in Bologna with Cimabue artwork
- [Torre Prendiparte, Bologna](https://www.italyguides.it/it/emilia-romagna/bologna/torre-prendiparte): Medieval Torre Prendiparte tower in Bologna, now a bed and breakfast
- [Cappella di Sant'Agata, Pisa](https://www.italyguides.it/it/toscana/pisa/cappella-di-sant-agata): Romanesque Cappella di Sant'Agata in Pisa by architect Diotisalvi

## Photo Galleries
